overview: The Resonance Core Chamber houses the Basilica’s central void‑arcane engine, the source of its geometric stability and instability.
history: Luclinite arcane orders built the core to harness void resonance safely.
Custodian constructs were created to maintain the core’s alignment.
Akhevan forces attempted to breach the chamber during early conflicts.
A resonance cascade destabilized the Basilica’s geometry centuries ago.
The core now pulses unpredictably, generating echo entities.
hooks: The core enters a dangerous overload cycle.
Akhevan ritualists attempt a resonance hijack.
Echo entities manifest in large numbers.
Custodian constructs malfunction after a pulse.
